articles.title: Linux Still Working To Clean Up The Realtek RTL8723BS 802.11b/g/n WiFi Driver In 2026
articles.summary: The Realtek RTL8723BS WiFi driver, supporting an 802.11 b/g/ SDIO WLAN adapter with Bluetooth 4.0 connectivity, was integrated into the Linux 4.12 kernel's staging area in 2017. This driver is essential for enabling crucial wireless and Bluetooth functionalities for this specific Realtek hardware on various Linux-based systems, reflecting continuous efforts in hardware-software compatibility within the open-source community.

articles.title: Groups Identify Wreck Found Near Site of Diver's Death
articles.summary: David VanZandt, 70, founder of Cleveland Underwater Explorers, tragically died in a June 2024 diving accident while actively working to confirm a shipwreck's identity. His passing occurred at the site where his nonprofit was dedicated to uncovering maritime history. This incident highlights the inherent risks involved in underwater exploration efforts to identify submerged vessels.
